metadata.interpolation_rule: per standard depth z: exact level, else linear interpolation between bracketing levels if their spacing <= max(10 m, 0.2*z); for z <= 5 m the shallowest level is used if within 10 m; no extrapolation otherwise
metadata.collocation: cell containing the profile position, same UTC day (daily fields)

climatology.label: Climatology
climatology.description: harmonic climatology fitted on the train split

metadata.independence_note: Argo profiles are independent of the model's inputs (satellite surface fields) but GLORYS assimilates Argo and the model is trained on GLORYS, so this is not independent of the training target. GLORYS-vs-Argo is therefore a reference for the reanalysis's own consistency, not an independent error estimate.
